parsed.explanation: State threat-framing is documented and traveller-facing: passports/visas must show sex assigned at birth, the X marker is eliminated, posts are cabled to refuse cases with sex discrepancies and to consider a permanent fraud ineligibility finding, and trans athletes are barred entry outright. Foreign governments issued advisories after detentions. Facilities bans in roughly 22 states, with one documented trespass arrest and custody harm (conversion-style policies, abuse in immigration detention). No criminalisation of trans identity itself and hate-crime coverage nationally, which keeps it above the severe floor — but the enforced document regime reaches every visitor and outweighs contested, partial protections.
